step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an IoT data ingestion and querying platform for SBB freight trains. In the ingestion flow, sensor data from a Producer (UserConsumerIOT) is ingested via a Lambda function, sent to a Kinesis Data Stream, processed and filtered by Kinesis Analytics, and passed to a second Kinesis Stream. From there, another Lambda function writes the normalized data into DynamoDB. In the query/consumption flow, an external Consumer algorithm requests data through API Gateway, which invokes the data management Lambda to fetch data from DynamoDB and return it back through API Gateway.

graph.name: SBB Freight Train Digital Twin Data Platform
graph.notes: Architecture for capturing, filtering, and serving train sensor data to create digital twin views for freight train inspection.

nodes.name: Producer
nodes.notes: Locomotive or track sensors sending real-time data

nodes.name: Ingestion Lambda
nodes.notes: Receives sensor data in any format and forwards it to Kinesis

nodes.name: Kinesis Stream (Ingestion)
nodes.notes: Buffers incoming raw sensor data stream

nodes.name: Kinesis Analytics
nodes.notes: Filters and reduces incoming high-volume sample data

nodes.name: Kinesis Stream (Filtered)
nodes.notes: Holds harmonized and filtered data stream

nodes.name: Data Management Lambda
nodes.notes: Manages data writes to DynamoDB and handles read queries from API Gateway

nodes.name: DynamoDB

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Exposes API endpoint for consumers and algorithms

nodes.name: Consumer

edges.notes: Producer sends raw sensor data to ingestion Lambda
Lambda forwards data into Kinesis stream
Kinesis stream feeds data into Kinesis Analytics
Filtered data is emitted to a new Kinesis stream
Data management Lambda reads filtered data from Kinesis stream
Lambda persists formatted data into DynamoDB
Consumer requests train condition data via API Gateway
API Gateway routes request to Data Management Lambda
Lambda queries DynamoDB for required data
DynamoDB returns queried data to Lambda
Lambda returns formatted response to API Gateway
API Gateway returns data to Consumer
